name: io.github.avivgerz-hue/unslop
title: unslop — 7-Pillar Design Craft Engine
description: Audit UI design, extract Design DNA, generate tokens, and create transformation blueprints.

tools.name: unslop_audit
tools.description: Audit six frontend source formats across 72 rules and score all seven design craft pillars.

tools.name: unslop_extract_dna
tools.description: Extract Design DNA from a CSS file or HTTP(S) URL and compile it into a complete design preset and Agent Skill.

tools.name: unslop_apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a built-in studio preset to project agent rules and merge unslop into .mcp.json without replacing other MCP servers.

tools.name: unslop_refactor_plan
tools.description: Generate UNSLOP-REPORT.md with a 7-pillar scorecard, exact before/after token translations, and prioritized file:line refactor steps.
